text.p: Construction firm Esprit Group Bhd requoted sharply higher in early Friday trading after it announced a joint-venture for an Indonesian toll road.
At 0150 GMT, the stock was up 1.00 ringgit to 12.00, after rising as high as 12.40. Esprit shares had been suspended since June 4.

The company said it was entering into a venture with the Indonesian Highway Authority P.T. Jasa Marga and a local company P.T. Mawatindo for the privatisation of the proposed Semarang-Demak toll road. The project is expected to cost 515 billion rupiah.
"The earnings impact (from the Indonesian deal) could be quite substantial," said the head of research at a local brokerage firm. "The market is receiving it (the news) quite positively."

Esprit also said it will conduct a rights issue of 22 million new shares on a one-for-one basis at 5.95 ringgit a piece, and another rights issue of 132 million irredeemable, convertible loan stock (ICULS).
